- open the app (maximize the window)
- add/remove to windows startup
- exit

- choice of landscape or portrait, and flipped (flip is applied only when uploaded to the screen)

These data fields and indicators should be possible to place freely on the screen, but there is also an option to activate a grid to snap controls.
For each fiels it should be possible to choose also the font, where applicable.
The app should have a setting for the editing window for light mode, dark mode and system default. At first execution, it should be set on system default.
To display data it should also support 
- pie chart, 
- data bars, 
- arrows (up, down for increasing and decreasing values)
- all the other features provided in the example app. 
Layers should be movable by drag and drop so that the order can be changed. 
The application should have a front end for creating a new design, load from disk (both the old format and in new json format), modify it, save it (both in the old format and in the new format in json format), upload it to the screen, etc.
When choosing a design from disk from a list, there should be the preview of the selected design.
Additionally, if the app finds that screen is connected (autodetect the com port), should show on the editor screen the com port, show a green icon in the system tray, and stream continuously the data to keep the screen updated.
If the app doesnt detect the attached screen, it should show a red icon in the system tray.
When minimized it should run in the windows tray. By clicking the tray icon it should maximize the window. by right clicking it should present the option to:
- open the app: shows on screen the editor window
- add/remove to windows startup
- exit: completely quits the application and stops refreshing the screen and kills all background processes
